newsitem.title: GERMANY: BONN SETS AUCTION FOR SERIES 123 BOBLS.
newsitem.headline: BONN SETS AUCTION FOR SERIES 123 BOBLS.

text.p: The German government will cease tap issuance to non-banks of its Series 123 Bundesobligationen bonds, or Bobl, and offer the Bobl to banks at an auction, the Bundesbank as fiscal agent said on Tuesday.
Banks bids are due by 0900 GMT on August 20.
Tap issuance of the Series 123 will cease at 1000 GMT on August 19. Terms for tap issuance of a new Series 124 Bobl will be announced then.

The government is aiming for a total volume of 10 billion marks ($5.4 billion) from the Series 123 Bobl auction to banks. That includes the portion the Bundesbank will keep for market-smoothing purposes.
